FN-O21CWJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 205
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 205 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Athletic Commission
until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
Page 1
